messages:
Morgan (Sales): Heads-up — HelioPay reported a ~2x p95 increase on their checkout flows starting 03/23 09:08 UTC. They see spikes from ~1.2s to ~2.6s and throughput drops when QPS > 40. Ticket SUP-4821. Can product/eng pick this up? :pleading_face:
Elena (Product): Thanks, Morgan. Can you confirm repro steps + whether this is Hosted vs Dedicated? @Chao (Eng-runtime) @Kevin (Oncall) can you triage and advise mitigation steps? :eyes:
Chao (Eng-runtime): On it. Any recent model rollouts or quantization flips for HelioPay's route? Also need route name + model version to start correlating metrics.
Morgan (Sales): They use Hosted inference, route=payments-prod-us, model=redwood-open-13b-q4. Last customer-facing deploy ~03/22 00:12 UTC (they didn't change config).
Kevin (Oncall): I pulled infra metrics — p95 jump lines up with a spike in KV cache miss rate and increased eviction activity on the pool serving payments-prod-us at 09:07 UTC. Dashboard snapshot: https://internal.redwood/graph/abc123 :link:
Kevin (Oncall): Quick log excerpt:
```
[09:06:52] node-23 eviction: kv_cache_pressure=0.78
[09:06:59] node-23 miss_rate=0.43 p95_tokens=1.9s
[09:07:05] autoscaler: added 1 instance to pool payments-prod-us
```
SupportBot: SUP-4821 updated — customer uploaded sample traces and set priority=high.
Elena (Product): Ok — two paths: infra (cache/batching) => eng runway + temporary fallback routing; model regression/quantization => rollback/adjust quant and run quality checks. Need ETA for triage and mitigation plan.
Chao (Eng-runtime): Hypothesis A: cache pressure from short-lived prefixes + a batch-size distribution shift. Hypothesis B: a subtle change in kernel selection after commit 9f2b3d introduced tail latency on q4 kernels. I'll check kernel selection logs and batch histograms. Mitigation idea: route 10% traffic to redwood-open-13b-fp16 fallback and bump KV cache size on the pool.
Kevin (Oncall): I can do a controlled 10% canary route shift now and watch p95. @deploy-bot please queue a routing update for payments-prod-us -> fallback 10%.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary routing update requested by @Kevin (Oncall). Starting rollout: payments-prod-us -> 10% redwood-open-13b-fp16. Notifying autoscaler.
Morgan (Sales): I told HelioPay we're implementing a mitigation and will follow up. They requested an ETA for a permanent fix and a short note for their SLA thread. Can we aim to confirm mitigations within 4 hours?
Chao (Eng-runtime): I'll have an initial RCA + actionable plan within 2 hours. If it's a config/tuning issue we can hotfix same day; if it's a kernel regression we'll need a rollback/patch which might take longer.
Elena (Product): Thanks team. Recording this as a customer-impact item for the roadmap backlog and scheduling follow-up in tomorrow's sync. Owners: Chao (primary), Kevin (mitigation/monitoring). Morgan — please add HelioPay to the support ticket with the canary details.
Kevin (Oncall): :thumbsup: monitoring p95 and cache metrics; will post an update in this thread once canary shows results.
Chao (Eng-runtime): First quick update: canary 10% reduced p95 for the affected traces by ~30% within 12 minutes. Still digging into why cache miss rate spiked.
Morgan (Sales): Great, passing that to HelioPay now. They appreciate the rapid response.
Elena (Product): Good progress. Keep notes of exact metrics & timeline for RCA doc. We'll revisit prioritization for a bugfix/rollout in the roadmap meeting.
